articles.title: One awkward hug, plenty of questions: USMNT fans react to Pochettino and Pulisic video
articles.summary: Mauricio Pochettino’s final days as head coach of the United States men’s national team have brought an unexpected talking point: his brief, seemingly awkward interaction with Christian Pulisic during a training session. A video recorded Friday at the U.S. Soccer training center in Fayetteville, Georgia, began circulating on social media, prompting fans to question whether there is tension between the outgoing manager and the team’s biggest attacking star. In the footage, Pochettino moves through the line of players, greeting several with warm embraces. When he reaches Pulisic, however, the exchange appears noticeably shorter. The AC Milan forward offers a one-armed hug, and the two quickly move on. The contrast was enough to get USMNT supporters talking.

articles.title: Fans storm Folsom Field as Colorado delivers its biggest win of the Deion Sanders era
articles.summary: Colorado gave its fans a night to remember Friday, and they responded by taking over the field at Folsom Field. The Buffaloes pulled off a major upset, defeating No. 14 Houston 42-32 in Boulder after producing their most complete offensive performance of the 2026 season. The victory marked Colorado’s first win over an AP top-15 opponent since 2007 and offered a significant boost to a program that had been struggling to find consistency under head coach Deion “Coach Prime” Sanders. It was also a potentially important moment for Sanders, whose future in Boulder has become a subject of speculation as the Buffaloes’ disappointing season unfolded. One win does not settle the questions surrounding his long-term plans, but beating a ranked Houston team in such convincing fashion gives him and the program something meaningful to build on.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes shares sweet family moment amid Patrick’s elbow injury concerns
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes may be focused on getting back to full strength, but a recent glimpse into his family life suggests the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback is also finding time to enjoy some quieter moments away from the football field. His wife, Brittany Mahomes, offered fans a behind-the-scenes look at the quarterback spending time with their three children as he continues recovering from an elbow injury suffered during Kansas City’s victory over the New York Jets. The video, shared on Brittany’s Instagram Stories, showed Patrick joining Sterling, Bronze and Golden for a family afternoon activity: decorating a cardboard playhouse. Although the scene appeared to be an ordinary family activity, football fans quickly noticed something interesting about the three-time Super Bowl champion: Mahomes was wearing a compression sleeve on his throwing arm.

articles.title: Harry Kane stuns NFL fans with insane 68-yard field goal
articles.summary: Harry Kane is used to making headlines for scoring spectacular goals, but the Bayern Munich superstar has found a completely different way to surprise sports fans: kicking a football through the uprights from an astonishing distance. A video shared by the Bundesliga has sparked a social media frenzy after showing the England international attempting an NFL-style field goal from 68 yards. The clip immediately caught the attention of football fans on both sides of the Atlantic, with some wondering whether the footage was generated using artificial intelligence and others convinced that Kane genuinely has the leg strength to compete with professional NFL kickers. The spectacle is particularly interesting because Kane’s fascination with American football is no secret. The Bayern striker has repeatedly expressed admiration for the NFL, has previously demonstrated his ability to kick long-distance field goals and has even discussed the possibility of becoming a professional kicker after retiring from soccer.

articles.title: No answers for Cooper Flagg: LaMelo Ball conducts Timberwolves’ 133-94 demolition of Dallas
articles.summary: The Minnesota Timberwolves delivered a statement performance against the Dallas Mavericks, turning a competitive matchup into a one-sided spectacle with a devastating third-quarter explosion. LaMelo Ball orchestrated the demolition, while rookie forward Cooper Flagg struggled to contain Minnesota’s offensive attack in a 133-94 victory at Target Center. The Timberwolves were simply too much for Dallas. What began as a relatively close contest quickly became a blowout after Minnesota took complete control in the third quarter, exposing the Mavericks’ defensive weaknesses and leaving Flagg with few answers. Minnesota improved to 9-3, extended its winning streak to five games and continued establishing itself as a serious force in the Western Conference.
